preconditions.description: The length of the permutation n must be between 1 and 50000.
The value of 2k must be non-negative and less than or equal to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly 2n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 2 * n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: All output integers must be distinct positive integers between 1 and 2n.

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(int(stdout.split()[2 * i - 1]) - int(stdout.split()[2 * i])) for i in range(1, n + 1)) - abs(sum(int(stdout.split()[2 * i - 1]) - int(stdout.split()[2 * i]) for i in range(1, n + 1))) == 2 * k
postconditions.description: The output permutation must satisfy the given equation.
